tagline: Maps and rankings from open data
brief: A YouTube Shorts channel of maps and rankings drawn in code from open data (USGS, World Bank). Calm documentary tone, one warm signal per video for the number that matters.
criteria: Distinct from flag and rainbow-globe map channels, readable as a 40 px avatar, works in one colour, ties to the single-orange-accent rule of the videos.

concepts.name: Off the scale
concepts.idea: A striped Earth whose middle band runs past the globe: the one number that stands out.
rationale: Same single orange accent as every video
Bands read as a ranking chart and as latitudes
A 3-band cut keeps it clear at 16-32 px

recommendation: Off the scale: the most ownable direction; the striped-disc kinship with the Eclipse IDE icon is broken by blue bands and the protruding bar.
next_steps: Upload avatar, banner and watermark in YouTube Studio
Use the small cut at 32 px and below
